in_hebrew.name: Pateriel
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Father of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Pateriel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew name 'Petrus', which means 'rock'. In Christian tradition, Pateriel is a name given to those who are strong in faith and serve as spiritual leaders. This name can be traced back to the New Testament, where Saint Peter, a disciple of Jesus, is given this name due to his steadfastness and unwavering belief.

in_latin.name: Pateriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomina masculina quae Patrem significant. Nomen est compositum ex verbis pater et iela, quae significat 'filius' vel 'filia'.
